C. No contract: the catalog was only an invitation to deal, the purchase order was the offer, and Costco’s confirmation was expressly conditional on the loading charge, so under UCC §2-207 it was a counteroffer that was never accepted. The common-law mirror-image rule in D does not control a sale of goods, and neither a $1,000 nor a $1,500 contract formed.

CONFIDENCE: 86
